steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Our forces have taken over every last part of County Hillock, save a few small pockets.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: The barracks didn't realize our true strength until it was too late, just as planned.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Did you see the looks on their faces? A force they thought to have been wiped out, and suddenly it reappeared. Like they were seeing actual ghosts.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Their greatest failure coming right as they were celebrating their victories. Not many Victorians left with any fight in them.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Grr. I almost forgot. My dear classmates are still struggling about in the outskirts.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Pitiful, pitiful. Their last ditch effort isn't going to change anything, and even if we don't so much as lift a finger, they've long been on their last legs, exhausted by the corruption of the military.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Mandragora's off looking for them. She's plenty enough to deal with the issue.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: All according to plan—all except one thing.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Loughshinny got away.
You mean to say my servants have failed.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: I'd be lying if I said I wasn't surprised. They may be fools, but they hardly claim the title of 'weak.'

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: That said, we have no need of them anymore.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Their ambitions grew all too quickly. They only knew to fan the flames of war for their own benefit, even plotting to use Loughshinny to carry out their plans right under your nose.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: In the end, off they went, engulfed by the flames of their own appetite. Saved us some trouble.
What about you?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: *Cough*... *cough*...

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: You know me. All I want... is to see the end.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: I asked you this when we first met—

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: If death is inevitable, and order will always collapse no matter how many times it is rebuilt, then how do those who walk this journey bear with these pointless decisions again and again?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: And you... you reached your hand out to me.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: You showed me that even perished souls can dance brilliantly in death.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Ever since, I've always wanted to see for myself just how this world looks beyond the flames.
Greedy, yet honest.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Hah... The biggest difference separating me and those fools is that I know when to lie.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: So, what will we do with Loughshinny?
My sister... Who did she pick?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: We don't know much about the ones who saved her, but they rescued a great deal of the city's residents.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: They seem like... a medical-something aid group?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: To tell the truth, I'm deathly curious. They don't seem to have much to do with any one country, so why stand up against us?
Hoh, that sounds interesting.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Should I bring along a few men to scope them out?
Your call, my cherished strategist.
Perhaps there will come a day when I take a good look at them myself.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Send word that the Victorian soldiers are our only targets. If anyone dares lay a hand on the civilians, they become an enemy of Dublinn.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Yes, ma'am.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: There are some civilians against us, though.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: We must first make them believe we're standing on their side, no?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: What the people need after such a traumatic event isn't harsher rule. It's all the help they can get.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Oh, yes. And you are not to harm the rescuers either—at least not within County Hillock, and not in view of the locals.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: The fire's burning plenty bright. It's about time to put it out before it consumes everything, and renders this all a pointless charade.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Soon, the wounds will heal, and the masses will remember who it was that made them so cruelly suffer, and who it was that pulled them back out of hell.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Dublinn warriors are not like the Victorians—

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: And this idea will forever be etched onto the city's heart after its rebirth, like a scar.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: What about the outsiders...? If we stop now, will they see it?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Anyone who's wanted for a look has already seen it.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: That's all we need to do?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Of course. What did you think was the point of all this?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: To make the Tarans' voices heard? Do you really believe that? Neither you nor I have an ounce of anything to do with Tara.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: To take over County Hillock? Only an arrogant clown would believe that. Victoria may stand on shaky, even precarious ground, but any of the dukes' armies could easily reduce a nomadic city to ashes.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: All we need to do is make sure the fire burns, so that all of Victoria will turn their eyes to it.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: And in the fire, some of them will have seen only profit, some will have made known their hatred, and yet some will have found faith. In a way, this is quite the happy ending, wouldn't you agree?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Let's go. We still have one last thing to take care of.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Once we finish with that, it'll be time for us to leave. The traitors who continue to about on the stage are far more despicable than any clown.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Before it's time for us to step into the limelight again, we should climb back into the graves that Victoria was kind enough to dig for us. Such is the spectre force—Wouldn't you agree, Hill?
'The entire city has fallen. Communication signal's lost. We can't reach any of the teams...'
'The enemy's charging the base. They've clearly got us vastly outgunned. We can't hold here much longer!'
'Report...'
'Calling HQ. Retreat immediately. I repeat, retrea—Aghhhhh!'

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Colonel, we have to go, now!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: We can't hold here. They have us surrounded—

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Go...? Go where?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Talk later! County Hillock's gone!

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Gone? Shut your godforsaken flap!

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: As long as I'm here, this city will never be lost! County Hillock will forever belong to the Victorian Empire!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: They won't show you any mercy, Colonel! They have no mercy for Victorians... Please, come with us!

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Go.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Colonel—!

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: What are you standing there for? Run! With your tail clutched between your legs and your head hung in shame! Don't you ever cross my sight again—unless you have a death wish!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Right... Right, then, we're leaving.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: P... Please, stay safe!

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: ...Hah.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Stay safe? On the battlefield?

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: How contrary to the meaning of a soldier.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: —Where's my blade?

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Here you are, old friend... How long has it been since you've last seen gunsmoke, since we last alighted a high-speed battleship together?

a.text: The sound of turret fire and screaming grows ever closer, before falling into silence for a brief moment.
A silence quickly followed by densely packed footsteps—that all come to gather in front of the tightly shut door.

steps.text: In the darkness, the colonel stands up from his chair and adjusts the collar of his uniform, before he steps toward the entrance.
He stands up straight, draws his standard-issue saber, and raises it at what lies outside.
The bright light of the blaze comes surging through.
'My saber and I hail from Victoria!'

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Oboe, Cello and I have made it to the communications tower!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: How is it looking on your end?

steps.name: Oboe
steps.text: Leader, I have explosives planted on platforms 1 through 7. Just waiting on the enemy now!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Very well, let's start with Number 1—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Good, the enemy is heading in that direction! Watch out over there.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Cello, climb up the tower!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Oboe, Numbers 2 and 3!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Oboe... I'm seeing more Casters approaching through the passageway. Be careful!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Watch the Casters' attack. I'm detecting a strong energy signal accumulating—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Keep your distance from the enemy!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: No, fall back immediately! Oboe, take your people and leave the passageway!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The enemy's Arts have too wide an effect area! They aren't even going to look for you. They'll wipe out all the platforms with one gigantic fireball!

steps.name: Oboe
steps.text: Understood, Leader. Let's see who's faster.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Oboe...!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Cello, Oboe bought us some time. Keep heading up!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Get the word out as soon as you find the control panel.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'll stay here at the bottom to provide suppressive fire.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Five minutes. You have my word, not a single one of them will be making it up the tower in the next five minutes.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Shells, ready to fire—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: How's it looking up there, Cello?

steps.name: Cello
steps.text: Still ten meters to go... Ugh...!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Are there hostiles up there?!

steps.name: Cello
steps.text: Crossbowmen...! Eight o'clock!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Hngh... There's too many of them!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: If I head up there, we won't be able to hold the bottom of the tower...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I can't get a lock on them... They're too far away for me to reach!

steps.name: Cello
steps.text: This isn't the time to worry about... that!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Don't do it! You'll bleed out before you reach the control panel!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Find cover!

steps.name: Cello
steps.text: We can't... drag this out! I know you're hurt too... Leader!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'm fine... *cough*...

steps.name: Cello
steps.text: Don't give me that, Leader. It's been six minutes. How many hostiles are there on your end? Twenty? Thirty? More?

steps.name: Cello
steps.text: Don't even have the leisure to talk, right?

steps.name: Cello
steps.text: It's seven meters away. I'll—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What's going on...?

steps.name: Cello
steps.text: Ah... hah! Leader, I'm fine! Someone took out the crossbowmen!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What? Could that be...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Leader!!! Look who's arrived—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Ah... haha... You little menace...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Hold on just a bit longer! Just a bit! I'll take down these fire breathers!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Cello, Bagpipe's drawing their attention. Hurry!

steps.name: Cello
steps.text: Leader... I got the control panel open! We're almost there... almost...

steps.name: Cello
steps.text: Ughh...!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Cello?!

steps.name: Cello
steps.text: Her... Her stones... Leader... Watch out...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What's going on?!!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: —Leader!
Bagpipe dives toward Horn, sending the two of them tumbling to the side.
A large stone column falls from the top of the communications tower, leaving a hole where Horn stood just moments ago.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Where'd this column come from...?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ugh... A spectre force Caster?!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Is she one of yours?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You killed Cello!!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Not a fan of people touching my things without permission.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What do you mean, yours?! It was the spectre force that invaded County Hillock!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Hmn... hah! Not even going to say hi before you fire?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: That's your Victorian Army etiquette, is it?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You...! Are you thick?! Don't you see you can't harm me? That you're wasting all your effort?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The rubble...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: (No weaknesses, no matter the angle.)

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: (Before my lance shells even get anywhere close, she maneuvers the stones around her to block off the attack.)

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: (Is that her Arts?)

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: (Take a look at Cello's body.)

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: (Was it the stones that bored through Cello like that? Whatever did it's all gone too... So she can manipulate stones to defend herself, AND conjure them as weapons?)

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: (Not the best news.)

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: (Let's test her and see how far she can go. I'm sure we'll find an opening.)

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Hmph. Got me wondering now if this is some suicide attempt.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Thanks to my men, I'm thinking you don't have much ammo left. If you keep shelling like that, you'll have nothing left to fight with. Then you'll just have to sit and wait as your death comes.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: To think Harmonie kept telling me over and over how impressive you were.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: 'Oh, they're the true face of the Victorian Army...' Hah. Look at you. Helpless, nowhere to go. Is that all a Royal Guard Academy distinction has to give?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: The way I see it, you aren't much better than the barracks... I'll make short work of you!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You hate the Victorian Army, don't you...?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Guess again.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: I don't hate soldiers. No matter whose orders you're taking, we're all poor little shits throwing our lives away in the mess of war.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: It's people like you I hate.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You have a decent family background, and you think that gives you the right to trample us lot under your feet—

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: What could be better than watching you kneel before me?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Go, run her through—!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Still have the strength to block?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You've got perseverance, Lupo. Much better than your fellow nobles who pissed themselves the moment they saw me.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: But you still can't work it out? You don't stand a chance!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Our forces have taken over County Hillock. Yours are dead or shackled.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Oh, and by the way, we've had eyes on you ever since you and your unit waltzed merry into Hillock. We've been watching your every move.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Hrgh... You have a spy in the barracks?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You thought you failed because of rotten luck? Or you weren't trying hard enough, misjudged? That's why you missed the chance?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Wrong! Fate has never been on your side!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Because—Victoria's long abandoned you!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You're more pitiful than all those poor sods dying ignorant on the field of war—you threw yourself into this bloodbath willingly! And now, you're just a sacrificial pawn for your country!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You mean... It's not just one spy...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The military's filled with your supporters... Even some of the top brass...?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: In that case... what is your leader after...?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Is it Victoria's... Crown...?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What right do you... have?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Shut your mouth!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: How—DARE you doubt our leader's nobility, when you're just a lapdog of the Aslans?!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Hah, haha...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: What are you laughing at?!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Your hypocrisy.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You grit your teeth, talking of arrogant aristocrats and moneyed men, but you worship your oh-so-noble 'Leader' all the same—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You can't make this stuff up, can you?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: And what... do you know?!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: The Leader... She's noble for more than just her blood! She... She's strong, and gentle...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Hah, I get it. You want to buy time for yourself and milk information. Am I wrong?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You think your tricks'll work on me?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You think it's going to matter even if I let slip something I shouldn't?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Neither of you will make it to the top of this tower—

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: And anyone hearing me is dead or soon will be!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You'll need to try harder—little Feline.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Grrr!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You're pretty good, I'll give you that. Very precise control over your weapon. You're trying to adjust your firing angle to pick out any openings in my Arts.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Too bad—If you weren't so heavily injured and had more ammo, you might just have given me a few scratches.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: This is it, then. Discussion time's over—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Now!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: What...? The column just... collapsed on me...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Man alive, my arms are sore with all that back and forth!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: That Vouivre...!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: And I thought she was berserking like an idiot. I never realized I wasn't her target. It was the columns at the tower base...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Dammit... Dammit! How did you know?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Leader, the rubble around her's clear!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: We made the right guess. She's agile with those Arts of hers, but she can only do one thing at a time—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Doesn't matter whether she's shiftin' the rubble to shield or usin' them as spikes, she's wide open while she's castin'!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The column's shattered her shield! Seize the day! Charge!
